review_notes: I read the whole file. I also read ExactStructure.lean (the conflation_of_isColimit_of_isInflation and conflation_of_isLimit_of_isDeflation lemmas) and Exact/Opposite.lean. Opposite.lean imports only ExactStructure and Mathlib, and it does not mention BaseChange. It provides ExactStructure.op and op_conflation_op_iff, so BaseChange.lean could import it without a cycle. The file contains two pairs of proofs that are line-for-line categorical duals, each 20 lines or more. The `key` plus `.choose` pattern also appears four times, but alone that would be a thin helper, so I did not report it separately. I could not run Lean. The op-transport proofs sketched below are unchecked, and they need one small identification lemma each about `.op` of the short complexes. I have not verified how smoothly the `.op` and `.unop` rewrites go.

findings.problem: The two theorems repeat one argument and are exact categorical duals. Each takes the kernel–cokernel pair of S and uses E2 stability to show the new map is an inflation or deflation. Each then shows Epi/Mono of the comparison map by cancelling through v or ι. Each builds a factorisation `key` from `hpair.desc` or `hpair.lift` and checks it with `sq.hom_ext`. Each finishes with `ofπ'` or `ofι'` applied to `.choose`. About 20 nontrivial lines are written twice, so any fix to one proof must be mirrored in the other. Opposite.lean already provides `ExactStructure.op` and `op_conflation_op_iff`, so the duality is available in the library.
findings.proposed_change: Import `TauCeti.CategoryTheory.Exact.Opposite` and keep only the cobase-change proof. Add one identification lemma, `(baseChange S sq).op = cobaseChange S.op sq.op` (or an isomorphism of short complexes). It reduces to `cobaseChangeπ S.op sq.op = (baseChangeι S sq).op` by `sq.op.hom_ext`, using the simp lemmas `inl_cobaseChangeπ` and `inr_cobaseChangeπ`. Then prove `conflation_baseChange` as follows: apply `E.op.conflation_cobaseChange ((E.op_conflation_op_iff S).2 hS) sq.op`, rewrite with the identification lemma, and close with `(E.op_conflation_op_iff _).1`. The instances needed on `Cᵒᵖ` (`Preadditive`, `HasZeroObject`, `HasBinaryBiproducts`) are already used by `ExactStructure.op`.
findings.benefit: This removes about 20 duplicated proof lines. Any future change to the cobase-change argument is made once. The file also records the duality explicitly instead of leaving two parallel scripts to be compared by eye.

findings.problem: These two proofs are also mirror images. Each gets the kernel–cokernel pair of the first conflation. Each shows the composite is an inflation or deflation via `isInflation_comp` or `isDeflation_comp`. Each proves `hc` (Epi or Mono) by the same hom_ext and cancel argument. Each constructs `key` by combining the square's `desc` or `lift` with `hpair₁.desc` or `hpair₁.lift`. Each finishes with `.choose` and `.choose_spec`. Only the direction of the arrows differs.
findings.proposed_change: Keep `conflation_comp_of_isPushout`. Derive `conflation_comp_of_isPullback` by applying it in `E.op` to `h₁.op` and `h₂.op` (via `op_conflation_op_iff`), with the opposite of the pullback square `sq.op` as the pushout. Then transport the resulting conflation back with `op_conflation_op_iff`. This needs only a small rewriting step, since `(ShortComplex.mk c (q ≫ p) _).op` is `ShortComplex.mk (p.op ≫ q.op) c.op _` up to `op_comp`. The same op-transport would also let `exists_conflation_comp'` follow from `exists_conflation_comp`, but that is optional.
findings.benefit: This removes another 20-odd lines of duplicated reasoning. It leaves a single proof of the composite-cokernel statement to maintain. The Noether and dual-Noether statements then share one core argument, in line with the file's own duality theme.
